Solutions for the end-of-chapter exercises in *Chapter 2 — Data Visualization*. The dataset is `olympic_athletes` (≈315k athlete-event rows, 1896–2026), accompanied by `medal_table` (medal counts per Games × NOC for 2018–2026) and `editions` (metadata for the five most recent Games), all from the [`olympicAthletes`](https://github.com/moderndive/olympicAthletes) package.

```{r}
#| label: ch2-coverage
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
#| message: false
helpers <- if (file.exists("scripts/exercise_helpers.R")) "scripts/exercise_helpers.R" else "../scripts/exercise_helpers.R"
source(helpers)
cat(render_coverage_callout(2))
```
